keyboardHint: Use the ← → arrows to move and Esc to skip.

welcome.title: Welcome to GamerMatch!
welcome.body: Find people to play with: open matches, compatible players and people who play the same games as you.

feed.title: Matches
feed.body: Home shows matches by category. Tap "See more" to explore a whole category and "I want to play" to join.

publish.title: Post your match
publish.body: With "Post" you create a match right away or schedule it for a date and time. You can say if you need a mic, the level and the language.

players.title: Find players
players.body: Look people up by name or check "Compatible with you": players like you based on your gaming preferences.

friends.title: Friends
friends.body: Send friend requests and accept the ones you get. In Friends you can see who's online.

chats.title: Chats
chats.body: Talk privately with any player or in each match's chat, with emojis and attachments.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: The bell tells you about requests, messages, comments and who wants to play in your matches.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Add your favorite games and social links, connect Steam to show your stats, set your gaming preferences and pick your language.

discover.title: News, guides and community
discover.body: Read gaming news, learn from other players' guides (or write your own) and see in Community where everyone plays.

safety.title: Your safety
safety.body: If someone bothers you, report or block them from their profile. Blocked users are managed in My profile.

closing.title: Ready to play!
closing.body: You can reopen this guide anytime from your avatar menu or from My profile.

question.title: Do you want this guide to show up again?
question.text: If you say yes, you'll see it once more the next time you sign in.

reopen.title: Guide closed
reopen.detail: You can reopen it from the menu anytime.

saveError.title: Couldn't save your answer
saveError.detail: Check your connection and try again.

profile.title: App guide
profile.text: Go over everything you can do in GamerMatch in a minute.
